violations.affected_code: IconButton(icon: isBright ? const Icon(Icons.dark_mode_outlined) : const Icon(Icons.light_mode_outlined), onPressed: () => handleBrightnessChange(!isBright))
violations.explanation: The button acts as a toggle between light and dark mode, but its current state is not exposed to assistive technologies (no isSelected/toggled semantics). The label is always 'Toggle brightness', so screen reader users cannot tell which mode is active or which mode activating the button will switch to.
